title.narrative: Historical Memory and Development in El Salvador

description.narrative:
This project seeks to capture and preserve the historical memory of the residents of Chalatenango, El Salvador, of their experience of mobilising community leadership and popular organisation in the context of a civil war. By sharing back photographs and research conducted in 1984 with the communities, and creating a permanent exhibition, the project hopes to strengthen local historical resources such as the Museum of Historical Memory in Arcatao and make them available to a wider audience across Central America through the Fundación Latitudes. By working with Universities, the project seeks to engage Salvadorean young people today in the effort to bring the impact of the civil war on community structures of leadership and political participation to a national debate.
The proposal is submitted by the Museum of Historical Memory of Arcatao, Chalatenango, the Fundación Latitudes / Centro de Fotografia in San Salvador, Professor Jenny Pearce, Department of Peace Studies, University of Bradford and Mike Goldwater, renowned photographer and filmmaker.
It involves a partnership of organisations and individuals who wish to ensure that recent efforts to open up the issue of historical memory of El Salvador's 12 year civil war recognise the impacts on its victims.
A particular effort will be made to encourage the participation of young people in this project, through inviting university students, especially those with family in Chalatenango, to attend planned workshops and meetings and to help with transcriptions and other tasks. The proposal will also work with three Salvadorean Universities: the UCA, the Universidad Nacional and the Universidad Don Bosco.
The legacy of the project will be permanent but its direct implementation will take place through a two week project between 7th and 23rd September 2014 of three workshops with rural communities in Eastern Chalatenango and two lectures and a workshop in San Salvador and exhibitions of photographs covering the civil war in El Salvador by Mike Goldwater.
